category_title: Students with a history of school failure and distrust of adults
scenario_title: Reading novels and the fear of book reports
minimal_context: The student is asked to begin reading a novel during the daily reading time at the start of the autumn term.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our daily reading. Please pick a novel and start reading the first chapter.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to read. I'm not good at it and I'm just going to fail anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to read a few pages and see how it goes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. Teachers always say that, but it's a trick. My old teachers always did this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We read novels every day here. What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not reading it. I know exactly what happens next—you're just going to make me write a book report about it when I'm done, and I'm not doing that.
